title: October 3, 2025 Blog Join Our Mission Lila Sciences is introducing the world’s first scientific superintelligence platform for life, chemical, and materials sciences. Read More
content: Lila Sciences is introducing the world’s first scientific superintelligence platform for life, chemical, and materials sciences. We’ve been building behind the scenes for about three years within the labs of Flagship Pioneering, attracting world-class talent, partners, and investors. We are honored to announce $200 million in seed capital to fuel our mission to build scientific superintelligence to solve humankind’s greatest challenges. In science, we dream, model, hypothesize, experiment, interpret results, and repeat. We seek truth. Today, artificial intelligence is mastering existing knowledge. In science, AI trained on millions of scientific papers, genetic sequences, and chemical structures can predict protein structures and model complex systems. But we believe there is more in the universe than what is on the internet. At Lila, we are building systems to allow AI models to conduct every step of the scientific method, offering the potential to radically increase the intelligence, speed, and scale of humankind’s ability to turn the wheel of science. We call this technology Lila’s Autonomous Science platform. Over the last three years, Lila’s team and Autonomous Science platform have demonstrated performance in multiple domains that exceed human and existing AI-powered benchmarks, including: While we are transforming the scientific method, we are also liberating the scientific mind–freeing talented scientists to pursue and gain new breakthroughs in time frames never before possible, enabling them to accelerate the wheel of scientific discovery from anywhere in the world. Scientific intelligence can be seen as a time machine, reaching into the future to bring new technologies into the present—whether they are seconds or decades ahead. The greater our scientific intelligence, the further ahead we can explore and the faster we can move civilization forward. We believe the freedom, creativity, and scale of this era of science will magnetize a new generation of brilliant human minds to the frontiers of scientific discovery, where the world needs them most. We are building the team to responsibly and ethically steward this important mission Lila is led by an exceptional team that brings depth and breadth of expertise across diverse fields including science, AI, robotics, organizational effectiveness, information security, and commercial strategy. We are humbled that our mission, progress, and team have garnered the attention of visionary investors. Lila has raised $200 million in committed seed capital from Flagship Pioneering, along with General Catalyst, March Capital, Altitude Life Science Ventures, ARK Venture Fund, Blue Horizon Advisors, Modi Ventures, State of Michigan Retirement System, and a wholly owned subsidiary of the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority (ADIA) to support the further development of the AI platform, autonomous labs, and infrastructure for rapid scaling. Increasing scientific superintelligence may be the most important mission in the history of science. This is our entire focus. We believe it is essential that Lila’s mission be pursued ethically, safely, and responsibly and with a resolute focus on truth-seeking and science to improve lives and the world we live in. We are entering a new age of boundless discovery. We invite those of you passionate about this mission to join us. Geoff von Maltzahn, Ph.D. Co-founder and CEO, Lila Sciences
